{"operationName":"UnreadNotificationsQuery","variables":{"product_area":"other","product_feature":"other"},"query":"query UnreadNotificationsQuery {
  me {
    id
    __typename
    unread_notification_count
    notifications(
      page: 1
      include_read: false
      just_mentions: false
      sort_direction: "DESC"
    ) {
      id
      ...VirtualNotificationFragment
      __typename
    }
  }
}

fragment VirtualNotificationFragment on VirtualNotification {
  id
  _id
  __typename
  unread
  type
  timestamp
  created_at
  avatar
  actor_name
  message
  team_name
  url
  activity_id
  report_id

  is_internal
  old_team_name
  team_submission_state
  readable_closing_substate
  amount

  pentest_start

  organization_inbox_name

}"}

{"operationName":"UnreadNotificationsQuery","variables":{"product_area":"other","product_feature":"other"},"query":"query UnreadNotificationsQuery {
  me {
    id
    __typename
    unread_notification_count
    notifications(
      page: 1
      include_read: false
      just_mentions: false
      sort_direction: "DESC"
    ) {
      id
      ...VirtualNotificationFragment
      __typename
    }
  }
}

fragment VirtualNotificationFragment on VirtualNotification {
  id
  _id
  __typename
  unread
  type
  timestamp
  created_at
  avatar
  actor_name
  message
  team_name
  url
  activity_id
  report_id
  report_title
  is_internal
  old_team_name
  team_submission_state
  readable_closing_substate
  amount
  bonus_amount
  is_user_first_to_agree
  target_username
  group_name
  custom_message
  expiration_date
  is_pentest
  pentest_name
  pentest_check_name
  affected_names
  pentest_start
  pentest_timezone
  award_amount
  award_amount_lead
  pentest_end
  start_time
  end_time
  new_vpn_state
  old_award_amount
  old_award_amount_lead
  bookmarked
  organization_inbox_id
  organization_inbox_name
  verdict_label
}"}

{"operationName":"UnreadNotificationsQuery","variables":{"product_area":"other","product_feature":"other"},"query":"query UnreadNotificationsQuery {
  me {
    id
    __typename
    unread_notification_count
    notifications(
      page: 1
      include_read: false
      just_mentions: false
      sort_direction: "DESC"
    ) {
      id
      ...VirtualNotificationFragment
      __typename
    }
  }
}

fragment VirtualNotificationFragment on VirtualNotification {
  id
  _id
  __typename
  unread
  type
  timestamp
